title: Dickson order on finite exponent tuples
statement: For every integer $d\geq0$, order $\mathbf N^d$ coordinatewise: $\alpha\leq\beta$ means $\alpha_j\leq\beta_j$ for every $j$. Every sequence $(\alpha_i)_{i\in\mathbf N}$ in $\mathbf N^d$ has indices $i<j$ with $\alpha_i\leq\alpha_j$. Every antichain $S\subseteq\mathbf N^d$ is finite, where antichain means that distinct elements of $S$ are incomparable for this coordinatewise order. Finiteness of a subset means the predicate of [def-sfb-finite-infinite-set].
